# LMNT

LMNT focuses on voice and audio manipulation, possibly leveraging AI to generate or transform sound for various creative and technical use cases

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/lmnt/.

## Actions

- **Create Voice**: Creates a voice in lmnt.
- **Delete Voice Info**: Deletes information about a specific voice in lmnt.
- **Get Account** (read-only): Gets an account in lmnt.
- **Get Synthesize Speech** (read-only): Synthesizes speech from text using a specific voice in lmnt.
- **Get Voice Info** (read-only): Gets information about a specific voice in lmnt.
- **Get Voices List** (read-only): Gets a list of voices in lmnt.
- **Update Voice Info**: Updates information about a specific voice in lmnt.
